experimental.method: On each fresh sector-bar date, classify the rotate-into name and the level-leader as DEFENSIVE (XLP/XLU/XLV/XLRE) vs CYCLICAL (XLB/XLI/XLE/XLF/XLK) and record which specific cyclical sector is the rotate-out. Grade the defensive rotate-into on a confirmation ladder: (a) trailing-confirmed = accel>0 AND rrgState in {Leading,Improving} AND rsMom1m>0 AND rsMom3m>0 AND rsMom6m>0; (b) acceleration-only-6m-soft = same but rsMom6m<=0 while rsMom1m>0 AND rsMom3m>0; (c) acceleration-only-3m-and-6m-soft = accel>0 AND rsMom1m>0 but BOTH rsMom3m<=0 AND rsMom6m<=0 (weakest). Independently flag a DEGRADING level-leader when the leader's rrgState moves Leading -> Weakening/Peaking and its rsMom crosses below 100 across consecutive distinct bar-dates. Emit a 'fading-defensive-leadership' signal when the defensive rotate-into drops a rung on the ladder (b -> c) AND the level-leader degrades, across a distinct-bar transition. Separately track rotate-out sector migration (which cyclical leg is Peaking) across bars. Cross-reference the cyclical-commodity real-assets flag (top models agriculture/broad/industrial/energy in Uptrend/Mixed with havens GLD/SLV/BTC-USD/IBIT in Downtrend) BUT gate it on freshness: mark the cross-current PARTIALLY-FRESH when the real-assets read's asOf is >=1 distinct bar-date behind the sector bar (carried), and FULLY-FRESH only when both legs share the same distinct market-bar date.
